scenes.headline: The Log Book, for staff
scenes.sub: Received by noon, out on the 1 pm bag
scenes.line: This is the Log Book, as Client Support and the branch see it. Receive the papers by noon, and send them on the one o'clock bag.

scenes.headline: Everything runs to the bag
scenes.line: Every day runs to the bag. Papers come in until twelve noon. Then they are checked, and put on their transmittals. At one o'clock the bag comes in, is cleared, and the mail given out. And it goes back down with the day's transmittals.

scenes.headline: One of you, each week
scenes.line: One of you has the bag each week, in turn. This week Sasha. Next week Kamla. Then Azariah, then Liz. The bag is done by one, while the whole team is still in, because the team leaves from two.

scenes.headline: What is waiting
scenes.line: The Queue opens on today's bag. Papers logged, and not yet handed in. Papers received, and not yet sent, grouped by department.

scenes.headline: Tick, and sign
scenes.line: When an agent hands papers in, tick them, and sign with your finger. If a department is wrong, change it. The Log Book learns from the change.

scenes.headline: What goes today
scenes.line: At twelve, whoever has the bag gets one e-mail. Everything to prepare for today's bag, by department, and what agents have not handed in.

scenes.headline: One press, ready to print
scenes.line: Build the transmittal. One department, one press. It is numbered, with the date collected and the date sent on every line, ready to print and go in the bag.

scenes.headline: Missed the bag? A reason
scenes.line: If something received before twelve misses the bag, the Log Book asks why at one o'clock, while everyone is still in. The reason prints beside the two dates.

scenes.headline: The bag, on record
scenes.line: Press Bag in when the bag is cleared, and Bag out when it goes. Every day's bag is on record. Who had it, what went, and what missed it.

scenes.headline: Did they get it?
scenes.line: Three working days later, the department gets one e-mail with a Yes and a No. A Yes is recorded. A No goes to sales support, and a Salesforce task opens for whoever collected.

scenes.headline: How the branch is doing
scenes.line: Insights shows how the branch is doing. The share that made its bag, hour by hour. Each department's answers. And a quality score for every agent.

scenes.headline: The day, in one e-mail
scenes.line: At five o'clock, the branch manager gets the day in one e-mail. What is late, what a department said it never got, and what was never handed in.
Receive by noon. Prepare it. On the one o'clock bag.
